claims.text: mapping — the GENERATED half of the architecture artifact. Two halves, deliberately separated: * MECHANICAL (here): what exists, what reaches it, what is dark, what is an island, and the counts. Derived on every run from the tree itself, so it cannot go stale between the moment it is written and the moment it is read.
claims.why: The chunk only contains an __init__.py that re-exports from .reach; it does not implement any derivation logic, so the claim about mechanical derivation cannot be verified here.

claims.text: * NARRATIVE (docs/adrs/*.md, the invariants): WHY a thing is the way it is. No scanner derives that, and pretending otherwise is how hand-maintained inventories rot.
claims.why: This claim references external documentation (docs/adrs/*.md) and a design principle; no code in this chunk implements or validates it.

claims.text: ``reach.analyse`` answers the question the structural index cannot: not "X imports Y" but "can a human or a tool get here at all".
claims.why: The function analyse is imported from .reach but not defined in this chunk; its behaviour cannot be verified.
